properties.title: US strikes IRGC tankers near Kharg Island
properties.summary: CENTCOM struck M/T Downy and M/T Stark 1, disabling them; M/T Kylo destroyed. Retaliation for IRGC ballistic missile attacks on US Navy ships.

properties.title: IRGC strikes in Strait of Hormuz area
properties.summary: Iran claims strike on US-linked vessel in Strait of Hormuz as part of escalating tanker war.

properties.title: US strike kills 4 IRGC aerospace members - Kermanshah
properties.summary: CENTCOM struck IRGC missile launcher in Kermanshah province; IRGC Aerospace: Reza Mohammadi, Shahram Jafari, Alireza Shakiba, Jafar Kahrizi killed.

properties.title: Clashes near Lyman direction - Donetsk Oblast
properties.summary: Clashes near Novoselivka, Druzhelubivka, and Lyman. Russia launched 167 drones overnight Sep 4-5. ISW: No advances either side Sep 5.

properties.title: IAEA ceasefire - Zaporizhzhia NPP
properties.summary: Localized IAEA-brokered ceasefire to repair 330kV Ferrosplavna-1 power line. Plant on emergency diesel since Aug 20 damage.

properties.title: Witkoff/Kushner arrive Kyiv for peace talks
properties.summary: US envoys arrive after meeting Putin in Moscow Sep 5. No-strike order on Kyiv in effect. Talks described as 'useful' but no breakthrough announced.

properties.title: Israeli strikes southern Lebanon kill 4
properties.summary: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon following alleged Hezbollah drone launch. Netanyahu: 'Qatar is a hostile state.' 9,000 killed in Israeli attacks on Lebanon since 2023.

properties.title: Russian-attributed sabotage - Leipzig airport
properties.summary: Germany formally blamed Russia for drone-bomb attempt at Leipzig airport Aug 4. Closed Russian House Berlin and Consulate Bonn. Explosives also found at electricity substations.

properties.title: Anak Krakatau eruption - flights suspended
properties.summary: 30-second eruption ejected ash to 15km. 301 flights cancelled at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport. 6 airports affected.
